scope: Corollary3 and AppendixD.2: both bounded rates, both polynomial branches, exact Orlicz substitution, canonical zero-variance selection and actual Gaussian width.
status_policy: All37 theorem endpoints passed build, forced source checks, strict transitive axiom audit and dependency graph checks. Complementary independent reviews cover the five geometry/bounded/polynomial/main modules and the two ψ1 modules without claiming self-review as independent. All15 exact source-bound units are accepted within Corollary3/D.2 scope; this is not release-wide certification.
representation_differences: A square Gaussian covariance factor represents the actual Gaussian law; singular factors are allowed.
After zero-variance deletion, k is the number of retained faces. The paper renames this retained count m. The Lean rates use k explicitly.
At k=0 the discrepancy and width are exactly zero; the displayed formulas consequently vanish and require no positive dimension assumption.
The canonical normal condition is required only for positive-variance faces. Original coordinate unit-variance assumptions are unnecessary after actual face standardization.

passages.title: Complete statement, exact scales and constant order
passages.inference: The common bounded/Orlicz coefficient and q-dependent polynomial coefficients precede every probability model, dimension, face family and parameter. The four conclusions use Jδ, J²s₄, JB, J²B and JK, respectively, with actual projected width and recomputed auxiliary functions.

passages.title: Zero-variance projections and threshold signs
passages.inference: Actual covariance variances determine the retained face index. Omitted projections are zero almost surely under both actual laws. Nonnegative thresholds delete exactly; negative thresholds have zero probability under both laws. The equality of threshold suprema and empty retained-family case are proved, not assumed.

passages.inference: The Gaussian pushforward is the square factor law of the actual standardized covariance. Lower orthants are actual measurable rectangles; taking the threshold supremum gives the claimed error comparison, with no terminal CLT assumption.

passages.title: Envelope-only polynomial class at JB
passages.inference: Pointwise norm control yields the actual q-envelope moment at exactly (JB)^q. The new envelope-only class has no coordinate fourth-moment hypothesis, including when 2<q<4. The new Theorem 2(i) is invoked at JB.
